subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box: 0.
stimulus: follow be lag work depend reach do idle remember build Bangladesh is full of natural resources. The true development of a country (a)_____ on the proper utilization of resources. We have to (b)_____ hard to (c)_____ up our country. We should not (d)_____ our days away. If we (e)_____ so, we (f)_____ behind. It must be (g)_____ that "Industry is the Key to Success." The developed countries of the world that (h)_____ industrious (i)_____ the pinnacle of success. We should have to (j)_____ them.
guide_solution: (a) depends (b) work (c) build (d) idle (e) do (f) will lag (g) remembered (h) are (i) reach (j) follow
